name: Obfuscated Command Execution via base64 -d
description: Detects use of the base64 utility with a decode flag, a common way to smuggle an obfuscated payload past static detection before piping it into a shell. Linux analog of the encoded-PowerShell rule. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_base64_decode_exec.yml, hand-converted from Sigma (no ecs_linux/auditd pysigma pipeline exists, so this EQL targets the real auditbeat auditd-module field shape directly).
query: any where process.executable like~ "*/base64" and process.title like~ ("*-d*", "*--decode*")
false_positives: Package install/build scripts that legitimately base64-decode an embedded asset
author: Sentinel
